description: Soprano is an ultra-lightweight (~80M) English-only text-to-speech model. Syntax uses a 17-layer Qwen3-style causal LM (hidden 512, vocab 8192) that autoregressively emits per-frame 512-dimensional features; a non-iterative Vocos-style decoder (ConvNeXt backbone + single ISTFT head, n_fft 2048 / hop 512) turns those features into 32 kHz audio. No diffusion refinement is performed in the decoder.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated audio frames for the autoregressive LM; default 512.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Autoregressive sampling temperature; default 0.3 (0 selects the framework default and clamps to a small positive value).

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: Repetition penalty applied to the LM head; default 1.2.

request.name: seed
request.description: Autoregressive sampling seed; omitted requests choose a random seed.

session.name: text_chunk_size
session.description: Maximum codepoints per sentence chunk before the model generates and decodes separately. Smaller values keep prompts short (more reliable EOS) but increase overhead. Default 200.

load.name: backbone_weight_type
load.description: Storage type for the Qwen3 LM backbone weights.

load.name: decoder_weight_type
load.description: Storage type for the Vocos decoder weights.

description.en: Soprano is an ultra-lightweight (~80M) English-only text-to-speech model. Syntax uses a 17-layer Qwen3-style causal LM (hidden 512, vocab 8192) that autoregressively emits per-frame 512-dimensional features; a non-iterative Vocos-style decoder (ConvNeXt backbone + single ISTFT head, n_fft 2048 / hop 512) turns those features into 32 kHz audio. No diffusion refinement is performed in the decoder.
description.zh: Soprano 是超轻量（约 80M）纯英语文本转语音模型。语法使用 17 层 Qwen3 风格因果 LM（hidden 512，vocab 8192）自回归逐帧输出 512 维特征；非迭代 Vocos 风格解码器（ConvNeXt 主干 + 单 ISTFT 头，n_fft 2048 / hop 512）将特征转为 32 kHz 音频。解码器不做扩散细化。

max_tokens.en: Maximum generated audio frames for the autoregressive LM; default 512.
max_tokens.zh: 自回归 LM 最多生成的音频帧数；默认 512。

temperature.en: Autoregressive sampling temperature; default 0.3 (0 selects the framework default and clamps to a small positive value).
temperature.zh: 自回归采样温度；默认 0.3（0 表示使用框架默认并截断为一个很小的正值）。

repetition_penalty.en: Repetition penalty applied to the LM head; default 1.2.
repetition_penalty.zh: 作用于 LM 输出头的重复惩罚；默认 1.2。

seed.en: Autoregressive sampling seed; omitted requests choose a random seed.
seed.zh: 自回归采样随机种子；省略时随机。
